about: When a town's term reads badly in an area, the people it touches organize; when it reads well, they gather to say so (owner, Nov 8: 'if you're having a good term except for education, then you might get a strike... or you show up to a rally, or if it's bad, you show up to a protest'). Each area names who it touches, what the action is when the term reads badly (a strike by the workers of the sector, or a protest) and the policy question those who act press on the town's officials. A rally has no demand: it is the town saying the term is going well. It holds no sentence and decides nothing: src/core2/modules/public-action.ts reads it with the term read (src/core2/term-read.ts).

gain.note: How much a month of a term read at full slide (1) adds to the town's organizing in that area, before the fade.

fade.note: The share of the town's organizing in an area that fades each month with nothing to keep it up: a steady slide of s settles at gain times s over fade, so a movement grows over months of a bad term and dies after one that mends.

minimumParticipants.note: The fewest people who are an action: one person alone is not a walkout, a protest or a rally.

faded.note: A level of organizing below this has faded out and is kept as none, so a town with nothing to organize about costs the monthly pass nothing. A month at full slide adds 0.5, so this is a thousandth of one.

movementLevelWeight.note: How much the town's organizing in the area (the stock a bad term builds each month and fades) weighs in a participant's decision to found a standing group over it, against the bar.

movementTurnoutWeight.note: How much the size of the crowd (the log of its people, named and counted) weighs in the decision to found a group; a bigger crowd carries more.

movementTieWeight.note: How much the participant's closeness to the others in the crowd (the sum of their ties to them, at most one) weighs: an organizer's capacity is the people who will follow them.

movementBar.note: What the case for founding must clear, with the participant's temperament added by the interest-groups lobbyist decision (speak out and engage against stay quiet and withdraw). Set so a fierce, large, well-tied crowd founds a group in weeks, a middling one in a few months and a weak one never; movements form over weeks to months (the sample of forming times is checked in public-action-movement.test.ts, one to six months).
